title: The Forest Doesn't End at the Fence
excerpt: Why we have chosen to live alongside wildlife without electric fencing at Forest Edge Estate.
body:
There is something we have always believed about living at the edge of a forest.. the land was never ours alone.

The elephants, leopards, deer and countless smaller creatures that move through this landscape were here long before us. Their paths existed long before property boundaries were drawn.

At Forest Edge Estate, we have consciously chosen not to install electric fencing.

It is not necessarily the easiest way to manage agricultural land. Wildlife and farming do not always agree, and sometimes nature has other plans for what we grow.

But we believe coexistence begins with recognising that we are part of a much larger living landscape.

Our aim is not to separate ourselves from the forest, but to learn how to live alongside it, with patience, observation and respect.

**We are not trying to keep the forest out. We are learning to live within it.**
